name: Turlach Unit 11 Original
description: This listing is a glass-transition noodle dryer listed with drying chamber volume 3800 litres, air temperature 29 degrees Celsius, moisture removal 38 kilograms per day. Its remaining stated figures are batch drying 30 hours, unit price set after acceptance, airflow pattern cross-flow. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
